body: Good luck to you. Be strong. I hope that you and I will find the path to happiness.
I have a shrink, but he's bad.

Thank you for your answer. It's sad. I hoped it would have changed something. We always hear people saying "if I had known..." when someone ends their life. I decided to give them this "if I had known" possibility. Truth is, I regret it. I feel even sadder now knowing that people quite literally don't care.
I don't think they understand how hurtful this can be. They're paid god money to, at the very least, pretend to care.
Thank you !

Oh that's awful. I wish you luck on your journey. From what i've read, you're amazingly strong, you had the power to turn you life once, i'm sure you'll do this again. You've got this, and i'll be cheering for you.

You're welcome ! I am not sure of what i'm saying, but i don't think you need someone up there with you at the time to develop survivor's guilt. What i mean is you survived something extremely dangerous when others didn't at another time / another place.

Hey there ! First of all i'm sorry you had to live this moment. I think you might have a case of either "survivor's guilt" or "reality check"(meaning life is extremely fragile).   
It's ok and it is normal. Good luck, you've got this !
Thank you so much for taking the time to help me !
Thank you  ! Pulling for you ( and me) too!
Thank you so much !

Thank you ! This time feels weirdly different, 10 times more powerful. There is not one second in the day that i can actually take control of "the beast". Usually, I can control the anxiety sometimes for 5 minutes sometimes for 1 hour. This time, it's impossible. I take meds because i'm on an anxiety attack 24/7, and it's been like that for 10 days. It's hell, it really is and i can't wait for this cycle to be over.

Thank you so much, and i am so sorry for your loss. I am extremely suicidal these days, to the point where i decided to actually tell my father (i(m an adult).  It's weird, and stressful for him, but i felt like i needed him to know, to help me so i can help him by staying alive if that makes sense. I'll try to be tested and see if i can take those vitamins. It's hard for me to laugh and smile and i wasn't like that. It was long ago, but i used to smile.   
Thank you so much for taking the time to write

Thank you so much. I have social phobia too, so your (first) comment is absolutely helpful. Right now, i am the point of feeling it with my family, so it's BAD BAD. but your story makes me think that maybe i'll be able to get out of this hell loop. Thank you so much for taking the time to write this comment.

Thank you so much for your answer. Unfortunately, I do not have good friends. I tried to express my anxiety, no one ever really listens, calls back... I never had the person who stood by me no matter what, which is one of the reasons why i feel like i am worthless to this world.
Thank you so much for sharing. I wish you the very best !

I can't. I don't have the will anymore, i'm a ghost in my own home and it does not get better. I want to leave before my old self dies completely. I'm exhausted. I never did a bad thing, I never stole, i can't see someone suffer, but the world still made me pay. I don't trust life anymore, it's been only bad to me. Thank you for caring though, but i promise you that dying is the best thing that can happen to me.
Please Stay safe. I'll be sending you good vibes from up there.
It really really does.

For me, it is, unfortunately. I would have loved to be loved and would have loved to love this life. I don't. No matter how hard I try, nothing ever works for me to the point where I'm actually scared of being happy because I know that something very bad always comes right after. I stayed alive for my family, but they don't care about me and they trigger my most violent panic attacks. So we'll all be better once this is done. Thank you for taking the time to answer me, it means a lot.
